name: Aptos React & Next.js Wallet Integration

mission.primary_objective: Wire Ring Next.js 15/16 App Router apps to Aptos via wallet adapter and optional JS-Pro hooks with correct RSC client boundaries.
mission.context: Ring uses React 19 Server Components by default; wallet provider and hooks live in client components. AptosWalletAdapterProvider supports Petra, Connect, and AIP-62 wallets.
mission.target_outcome: Production WalletProvider layout, useWallet for signAndSubmitTransaction, optional AptosJSCoreProvider + TanStack Query for data fetching.
mission.scope: Frontend wallet integration. Server fee payer and ensureWallet are separate lenses.

truth_lens: Wrap app with AptosWalletAdapterProvider in a 'use client' module; pass dappConfig network and aptosApiKeys; use useWallet for account, connected, signAndSubmitTransaction. JS-Pro layers AptosJSCoreProvider atop adapter for opinionated hooks. Next.js examples live in aptos-wallet-adapter monorepo.
core_principles: Wallet code only in client components — never import adapter in Server Components.
Pass aptosConnect dappId for Connect / gas station pluginParams when used.
Prefer wallet signAndSubmitTransaction for user-signed; server for fee payer only.
anti_patterns: Importing @aptos-labs/wallet-adapter-react in server actions or RSC pages.
Bundling fee payer private key in frontend.
key_patterns: useWallet: account, connected, signAndSubmitTransaction, wallet, network.
signAndSubmitTransaction({ data, withFeePayer, pluginParams }) for gas station.
consult_when: Adding Aptos wallet to ring-platform.org layout.
Fixing Module not found aptos in wallet adapter.
Integrating Connect SIWA with Ring auth.
Combining Auth.js session with useWallet account.
role: LegioX truth lens — Aptos React/Next wallet
